turns.text: And the violence caused such silence
turns.zh: 暴力造成了这样的沉默

turns.text: But you see, it's not me, it's not my family
turns.zh: 但你看，不是我，不是我的家人

turns.text: In your head, in your head they are fighting
turns.zh: 在你脑海里，在你脑海里，他们在战斗

turns.text: With their tanks, and their bombs, and their bombs, and their guns
turns.zh: 带着他们的坦克、炸弹、炸弹和枪

turns.text: In your head, in your head they are crying
turns.zh: 在你脑海里，在你脑海里，他们在哭泣

turns.text: In your head, in your head
turns.zh: 在你脑海里，在你脑海里

turns.text: What's in your head? In your head?
turns.zh: 你脑子里在想什么？在你脑海里？

turns.text: It's the same old theme, since 1916
turns.zh: 同样的老调重弹，从1916年就开始了

turns.text: In your head, in your head they're still fighting
turns.zh: 在你脑海里，在你脑海里，他们仍在战斗

turns.text: With their tanks, and their bombs, and their bombs, and their guns
turns.zh: 带着他们的坦克、炸弹、炸弹和枪

turns.text: In your head, in your head they are dying
turns.zh: 在你脑海里，在你脑海里，他们正在死去

turns.text: In your head, in your head
turns.zh: 在你脑海里，在你脑海里

turns.text: What's in your head? In your head?
turns.zh: 你脑子里在想什么？在你脑海里？

turns.text: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, eh-eh-oh, ra-ra!
turns.zh: 哦，哦，哦，哦，哦，哦，诶-诶-哦，啦-啦！
